fresh_route: hierarchical memory fidelity and verbatim-recovery boundary

sources.source: TiMem: Temporal-Hierarchical Memory Consolidation for Long-Horizon Conversational Agents, Findings of ACL 2026
sources.projection: Temporal-hierarchical memory can consolidate raw observations into progressively abstract representations and adapt recall granularity to query complexity.
sources.rakl_absorption: Use hierarchy for navigation, but keep canonical evidence leaves and distinguish abstraction from evidence authority.

sources.source: HiGMem: A Hierarchical and LLM-Guided Memory System for Long-Term Conversational Agents, Findings of ACL 2026
sources.projection: High-level event summaries can act as semantic anchors for deciding which lower-level turns deserve inspection, reducing bloated evidence sets.
sources.rakl_absorption: Coarse nodes may route retrieval to fine nodes, but the fine source closure remains explicitly reachable and content-pinned.

sources.source: OCR-Memory: Optical Context Retrieval for Long-Horizon Agent Memory, ACL 2026
sources.projection: A locate-and-transcribe design can use compact/high-density representations to navigate history while recovering verbatim text instead of relying on free-form generated reconstruction.
sources.rakl_absorption: Separate navigation representation from exact evidence recovery; a compact view is source-rehydratable rather than self-reconstructing unless exact regeneration is independently witnessed.

sources.source: Beyond Semantic Organization: Memory as Execution State Management for Long-Horizon Agents (MAGE), arXiv:2606.06090
sources.projection: Memory organization must preserve task-state dependency structure and isolate flawed branches, not merely cluster semantically similar history.
sources.rakl_absorption: Preserve lineage, branch identity, negative-history roots and source-state boundaries through derived views.

sources.source: Context Length Alone Hurts LLM Performance Despite Perfect Retrieval, Findings of EMNLP 2025
sources.projection: Longer context can reduce downstream performance even when all relevant information is retrievable, so merely preserving recall does not establish an optimal working-memory policy.
sources.rakl_absorption: Keep storage/reconstructability validation separate from matched downstream context-policy evaluation; do not infer whole-system gains from memory recall alone.

six_role_panel.cognitive_science_analogy: Supported coarse-to-fine navigation but required preservation of relational/negative evidence when abstraction changes level.
six_role_panel.knowledge_representation_ontology: Required typed direct source pins, transitive canonical roots, erasure metadata and no new authority certificates in derived representation objects.
six_role_panel.scientific_ir: Favored summary-as-anchor then evidence rehydration rather than summary-as-final-evidence.
six_role_panel.applied_math_systems: Required a finite acyclic source DAG, immutable source-hash pins and separate SOURCE_REHYDRATABLE versus REGENERATION_VERIFIED states.
six_role_panel.computational_creativity_search: Favored multiple resolution views as alternate navigation coordinates rather than one destructive canonical summary.
six_role_panel.adversarial_scientific_method: Targeted dangling sources, stale hashes, cycles, dropped contradiction sides, false lossless claims and authority escalation.

panel_disagreement.question: Should a declared transform name be sufficient to call a view reconstructable?
panel_disagreement.resolution: No. The systems/IR roles accepted it as a useful regeneration recipe, but the adversarial and epistemic roles required an externally verified reconstruction witness before exact regeneration authority is claimed. Without that witness, only source rehydration is licensed.

new_residual.observation: Recent long-context work shows downstream performance depends on context length, position and distance between relevant pieces even when retrieval succeeds. Round 021 does not change ordering policy because no ordering benchmark was frozen before this implementation.
new_residual.next_test: Freeze matched worlds varying order/separation of contradiction sides, ancestry chains and multi-hop evidence under identical selected records before implementing an order policy.

empirical_falsifier: If simpler flat or ordinary hierarchical memory preserves the same source recall, negative history, contradiction coverage and downstream research decisions at equal or lower cost, the reconstructability support layer should remain optional.
